verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is that users can revoke access to their connected accounts at any time and that stored credentials are encrypted at rest. That gives some control over stored credential connections, but nothing documents retention policies, retention windows, or deletion of data processed through tool calls. missing for 10: configurable data retention policies, documented deletion of user data and tool-call logs (including whether revocation deletes stored credentials), retention period disclosures, deletion APIs/SDK methods, independent corroboration
